item.title: Maxim arrives in Ormoc
item.description: Maxim has started operations in Ormoc City, giving residents another app-based option for car trips, tricycle bookings and deliveries. The Maxim app now lists four-seater and six-seater car services, Trike and Bike Delivery in the city. Starting fares are P45 for four-seater cars, P55 for six-seater

item.title: Toyota’s BRC test
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) will take the 2026 TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Philippine Cup to the Batangas Racing Circuit on 15 August, where drivers will race on one of the country’s oldest permanent tracks for the first time this season. The races are open to the public and admission is free.
